parsed.explanation: Combined regime pairs national birth-sex document and entry-screening rules with Oklahoma birth-sex facilities, schools, sports and public-care bans. Discovery can trigger refusal, fraud investigation, trespass arrest and birth-sex custody, where documented custody abuse and hormone removal occur. No execution or routine imprisonment for identity, private care remains, emergency care is exempt, existing X passports remain valid, and courts have enjoined some orders and are hearing passport litigation. That places consequences above 0.25 anchors but tier-1 facility/custody exposure without effective state remedy keeps it below 0.55.

entry_documents.exposure: National binary passport rule, no new X markers; entry cable directs refusal for document discrepancy and possible permanent fraud ineligibility. Visitor passports confiscated/blocked reported.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid until expiry; passport suit pending and Supreme Court action followed prior policy; scale of refusal is not automatic.
entry_documents.interaction: Document discrepancy can escalate to investigation, detention and birth-sex placement; foreign home passport may match presentation, but doubt triggers secondary process.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National corrections policy from 2026: hair cutting, hormone removal, psychiatric substitution. Immigration custody reports: forced labour, beatings, solitary, severe sexual abuse of trans men.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: No documented visitor custody protocol; litigation and advocacy exist, but no documented remedy stopping reported practices.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Facility trespass arrest example resulted in 24 hours in men's ward; any detention can convert to birth-sex custody harm.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Oklahoma K-12 birth-sex bathroom/changing bans 2022/2025; 2023 order extends birth-sex definition to state-owned facilities, shelters, crisis centres, incarceration. Neighbour arrest shows trespass enforcement.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Bans are government/school-focused, not all private settings; one city bans discrimination in public accommodations; trespass requires wilful entry plus refusal to depart.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Facility use can lead to arrest, then custody placement; national facility principle reinforces state rules in federal buildings.

care_services.exposure: SB 904 (2026) bars public funds, Medicaid and state facilities for gender-affirming care for minors and adults; intentional employee violation is misdemeanour.
care_services.protection: Patients face no penalties; private facilities, private insurance/out-of-pocket, mental-health, intersex, complication and emergency care exempt.
care_services.interaction: Public-care denial does not itself trigger detention, but hormone interruption in custody is documented nationally.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Executive orders define sex by birth, rescind pronoun/name policies, investigate pronoun use, ban trans athletes; counterterrorism language lists 'radically pro-transgender' actors.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Several orders blocked/enjoined; national hate-crime statute covers gender identity; 2020 employment ruling remains law.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Threat framing raises police/administrative discretion at borders, schools and facilities, especially where state law mirrors national policy.

minors_guardians.exposure: Minor must use birth-sex school facilities and is barred from school sports consistent with identity; public gender-affirming care banned; order directs prosecution over social transition facilitation.
minors_guardians.protection: No patient penalty under SB 904; private care and emergency/mental-health exemptions remain; several national measures enjoined or in litigation.
minors_guardians.interaction: Parent/guardian faces school, facility and care-access constraints, but dossier does not document routine parental arrest for travel or care seeking.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: State hate-crime law does not cover gender identity; 2018 resident death threats and 2024 school-bathroom death context show hostile local climate, not visitor-specific incidents.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime penalties available; one city prohibits discrimination; no state-specific visitor violence documented.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Lack of state recourse increases reliance on national prosecution, which is slower for a short-stay visitor.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No state gender-identity discrimination protection; at-will employment; passport, executive-order and HB 1225 outcomes unresolved; licence-marker current status not documented.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Courts hear challenges, legal-aid FAQ exists, national protections remain; specific July 2026 traveller grade for Oklahoma is not documented.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Unresolved litigation means operative rules at travel time govern; partial injunctions reduce some national exposure but not Oklahoma facility/care bans.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar tier-1 birth-sex custody and facility arrest exposure, but Oklahoma visitor imprisonment is not routine and lethal custody is not documented as frequent practice, so safer than 0.25.

Similar universal exclusion and discretionary border/facility enforcement with weak remedy, but Oklahoma adds documented severe custody abuse and school/minor bans, while retaining court challenges and private care.

Higher than 0.55 because entry discrepancy can support permanent fraud finding and facility violation can lead to arrest/custody, whereas 0.55 is mainly administrative delay and refusal without that custody pathway.

parsed.synthesis: Interaction is cumulative: birth-sex documents prompt entry scrutiny, state birth-sex facilities create arrest risk, and detention exposes visitor to birth-sex placement, hormone removal and reported abuse. Oklahoma has no state discrimination or hate-crime cover, and public care bans affect minors and adults. Mitigations are real but limited: private care, emergency exemptions, existing X validity, national hate-crime/employment law, and active litigation with some injunctions. No credible execution or routine imprisonment for identity prevents a severe-risk score, but tier-1 universal exposures without working state remedy keep rating in high-risk range.
